name: Post Types Slider
author: Waqas Ahmed

sections.description:
Post Types Slider is a powerful and flexible plugin that lets you create stunning sliders and carousels from any WordPress post type, custom post type, or category. With an intuitive settings panel and dynamic live preview, you can build professional, responsive sliders in minutes—without writing a single line of code.

Perfect for showcasing blog posts, products, portfolio items, testimonials, or any custom content type.

Key Features:

  • Slider Type & Layout Options – Create and edit sliders with support for both grid and carousel layouts.
  • Post Type Selection – Choose any WordPress post type, including custom post types, for dynamic content display.
  • Category & Taxonomy Filters – Display posts from all categories or filter by specific category terms.
  • Sorting Options – Sort posts in ascending (ASC) or descending (DESC) order for flexible display.
  • General Settings – Show or hide titles, descriptions, thumbnails, carousels, and navigation arrows.
  • Styling Controls – Customize fonts, colors, and layouts with dynamic options and live preview.
  • Button Settings – Adjust button styling, colors, and padding to match your theme.
  • Responsive & Touch-Friendly – Built with Slick Slider for smooth swipe and mobile support.
  • Shortcode Integration – Easily embed sliders anywhere with simple shortcodes.

Usage

To display a slider, use the shortcode:

[posttysl_slider id=74]

Parameters:
– id (required) – The unique identifier of the slider you wish to display.

You can create multiple sliders, each with its own configuration and shortcode.

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPLv2 or later.
For details, visit https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-2.0.html.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the Plugin Files

    • Upload the post-types-slider folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.

  2. Activate the Plugin

    • Go to the Plugins menu in WordPress and activate Post Types Slider.

  3. Configure Your Slider

    • Access the plugin settings from the admin panel, create a slider, and configure its options.
sections.faq:
Q: Can I create multiple sliders with different settings?

A: Yes, you can create as many sliders as you like, each with unique layouts and filters.

Q: Does it support custom post types?

A: Absolutely. Any registered custom post type can be displayed in your slider.

Q: Can I customize the look of the slider?

A: Yes. Use the built-in styling options with live preview, or add custom CSS for full control.

Q: Is it mobile-friendly?

A: Yes. The slider is fully responsive with touch and swipe navigation support.
